label.explanation: redis-cache came back empty after a node replacement (line 173). With ~every lookup missing (lines 177, 188), search-api sent its whole read load to catalog-db, saturating its connections and CPU (lines 180, 191, 199). The slow queries (lines 185, 202, 217, 226, 245, 254, 277, 289), search-api query timeouts (lines 192, 212, 238, 260, 279) and web-bff 504s (lines 194, 200, 207, 220, 230, 237, 246, 255, 263, 274, 280, 285) are the cascade, not separate problems. Warm the cache / rate-limit fills. catalog-db is genuinely exhausted, so resource_exhaustion is defensible, but it was pushed there by the empty cache. Red herrings: line 26 (a routine disk usage warning on the log volume, nowhere near full); line 176 (a single long GC pause in a healthy service, with heap well below limits); line 162 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); lines 60, 61 (a single translation API connection reset that succeeded on retry, minutes before onset).
